title: Research map: render typed relationship edges
description: The 9 typed relationships are validated in src/model.rs but never rendered. Implement the orientation.research-map kind so every declared edge is emitted with both endpoints and its relationship type, instead of type-grouped lists, and admitted entities without edges are still listed. Spec requirement: edges_rendered in openspec/changes/add-document-taxonomy/specs/kaya-documents/spec.md (scenario edges_rendered).
acceptance_criteria: Every declared edge in the fixture graph appears exactly once with both endpoints and its type; isolated entities are listed once; the build is deterministic. Anti-goals: no spec edits, no invented edges, no type-grouped listing presented as the map. Meter: cargo test --test research_map && openspec validate --changes --strict.

title: Implement Hegel property tests
description: Follow the research ticket at the pinned commit. Add hegeltest = "=0.52.7" with features = ["static-engine"] as a dev-dependency and .hegel/ to .gitignore. Implement the approved pure/ledger properties first; add the subprocess status/build property only if the research accepts the cost. Do not change the ledger format or recovery behavior as part of this ticket; file separate bug tickets for silent correction loss and the status/build digest mismatch.
acceptance_criteria: Approved properties are implemented as deterministic, isolated tests; cargo test is green; product behavior is unchanged; .hegel/ is ignored; build and runtime are recorded in the ticket; any discovered bugs have separate tickets. Anti-goals: no ledger format or recovery-behavior change in this ticket, no edits to the approved property list. Meter: cargo test && git check-ignore .hegel/.

title: Research: Hegel property-based testing plan (antithesis-research)
description:
Run the Antithesis research skill (antithesis-research) on this repo at a pinned commit (the tree moved during the suite evaluation from 510751b to fbd08ac; re-pin first). Scope: the JSONL ledger, correction resolution, event serialization, and status/build envelope.

Baseline candidates: (1) correction targets resolve totally (no silent observation loss; correction chains included), (2) one event is one line and parse_line(to_line(e)) == e, (3) status and build digest the same bytes (subprocess; note that status may mutate on read), (4) concurrent append keeps ids unique (design issue; assess separately).

Deliverable: antithesis/scratchbook artifacts in this repo; per property: invariant, check mode, seam, generator sketch, predicted red/green. Note the exact pin used and the recovery-on-read behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Scratchbook artifacts exist with per-property evidence; each property has an invariant, check mode, seam/generator plan, and predicted red/green status; the exact pin used is recorded; the recommendation states whether and how to use Hegel here; no production code or test changes. Meter: the scratchbook files exist and cite the recorded pin.
notes: Method: run the antithesis-research skill from https://github.com/antithesishq/antithesis-skills (read the skill before starting). Engine under evaluation: https://hegel.dev/ (crate hegeltest 0.52.7). Suite evaluation and property baseline: reports/hegel-eval-2026-11-16/README.md and antithesis/scratchbook/property-catalog.md in the charly superproject.

title: kaya.event/v0 schema + append-only JSONL ledger store
description: Event schema + append-only ledger store (kaya.event + kaya.ledger capabilities; tasks.md 1.1, 1.2, 2.2). Core event format is the closed nine-field set fixed by the kaya-event spec: id, schema, type, timestamp, actor, subject, data, provenance, artifacts — `project` is NOT an event field (project identity lives in node ids `<project>/<TYPE>/<key>` and in the ledger location). Red: parser round-trip incl. rejection of malformed events (missing timestamp, unknown schema version, missing provenance, id reuse, extra field); ledger fixtures: append-only byte check, supersede round trip, idempotent replay, digest stability, crash-tail (partial last line) recovery. Green: serde types + validator + JSONL store. Refactor: dedupe by (type, subject, provenance) per design. Demoable milestone: ledger round-trips events end-to-end (append -> replay -> stable digest). Contract tests: kaya.event + kaya.ledger scenarios execute under ah check --run-tests (archive checklist).
close_reason: MVP-1 implemented, verified (cargo test 128, clippy -D warnings, just ci), pipeline run complete

Meter: cargo search kaya returns the published version or the release run logs the publish step succeeding.

title: Understanding decision evidence has no Decision-to-Source link
description: understanding.decision-record renders every Source node as Evidence because the graph has no relationship from a Decision or its influenced Findings to a Source. Needs a model relationship (or an evidence-reference convention) before the evidence rows can be scoped; record the decision and update the renderer and tests.
